comparison.objective: Replace the blown fuse in the named DIN-rail holder with the correctly rated spare and relatch the carrier.
comparison.physical_skill: Select the correct part, open a small hinged carrier, remove and insert cartridge fuses, close the latch, and avoid adjacent holders.
comparison.success_condition: Correct KTK-6 fuse seated in F2, carrier shut and passing a 4 N pull check, old fuse in the tray; opening neighbors or installing KTK-10 latches zero.
comparison.reason: Part selection, cartridge replacement, and carrier relatching differ from setting a continuous mechanical angle, counterholding a screw during jam-nut tightening, and repeated actuation checks.
